messages:
alice_partnerships: hey all — spun up a repo `marketplace-iac-starter` as a clean, minimal terraform starter for marketplace partners. goal: make a copy-paste starter that validates in 1 region and documents packaging steps. repo: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-iac-starter
ben_cloud: sweet. can we scope v0 to: terraform module, minimal sample service manifest, CI smoke workflow, and a docs quickstart? skip heavy packaging for now.
chloe_infra: +1. for CI let's limit to a single cheap instance family and one region to keep cloud spend low. propose: `us-west-2`, `t3.medium` for the smoke only.
dmitri_eng: sample should exercise actual L7 traffic to the inference node (small request payload) and surface latency via a /health and /metrics endpoint. add a tiny python flask app for the sample.
fiona_pm: product ask: include a short FAQ in docs: "What counts as supported for marketplace listing?" and a one-paragraph market copy we can hand to partner marketing.
alice_partnerships: will add FAQ. thinking to include two var files: `marketplace.tfvars` (marketplace packaging off by default) and `demo.tfvars` (quick local demo).
grace_docs: i'll draft the quickstart and a partner-review checklist. also will need a screenshot flow for marketplace submission steps.
chloe_infra: CI sketch (GH Actions):
```
on: [push]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup terraform
        run: terraform init
      - name: Plan
        run: terraform plan -var-file=demo.tfvars
      - name: Apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=demo.tfvars
      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          url=$(terraform output -raw sample_endpoint)
          curl -fsS "$url/health" || exit 1
```
keep it short and ephemeral.
build-bot: repository created: github.com/redwood/marketplace-iac-starter by alice_partnerships
dmitri_eng: docs should include a very short "AMI bake" appendix that links to our golden AMI pipeline and notes for partner builders (bake -> test -> publish). we can link to internal cookbook rather than re-write.
alice_partnerships: agreed; include link and a short checklist: bake, run tests, verify metrics, publish manifest.
ben_cloud: packaging note: marketplace vendors often want an artifact (AMI/Image manifest). we'll include a `packaging/README.md` with sample commands and a placeholder `build-image.sh` that partners can customize. mark as optional.
chloe_infra: annotate terraform providers with exact versions in `versions.tf` and add a sample `backend.tf` for s3 remote state (encrypted). don't commit secrets obviously.
grace_docs: will add a "notes-for-partners.md" that lists required tests, minimal security checklist, and things to call out during partner review (region availability, instance family notes).
fiona_pm: timeline: partner Eng requested a tech-share in 18 days. can we do internal review in 7 days?\allice_partnerships: small typo in my name above^^
alice_partnerships: (fix) yes internal review in 7 days is doable if we keep scope tight. packaging optional for the 7-day ship.
dmitri_eng: i'd like a small telemetry opt-in example (Prometheus client) in the sample service so partners can see basic QPS/latency. make it explicit that telemetry is opt-in.
enchloe_infra: also add a `destroy` step in the CI docs and a short rollback / cleanup snippet in quickstart so partners don't leave resources running.
ben_cloud: recommend LICENSE = Apache-2.0 and a CONTRIBUTING.md with a quick note about partner forks and support expectations.
allice_partnerships: thanks — adding license and contributing.
build-bot: pull request opened: #1 by alice_partnerships -> main (marketplace-iac-starter)
dmitri_eng: reviewing PR now, will leave inline suggestions about the sample app Dockerfile and metrics route.
grace_docs: starting quickstart draft, attaching to PR in a few hours.
fiona_pm: remind: include an explicit line in quickstart re: cost estimate and recommended dev vs prod instance types. one sentence each.
alice_partnerships: done, will push updates tonight and tag reviewers. thanks everyone :rocket:
